items.title: Liberty endovascular robotic system demonstrates technical success in new case report
items.summary: Microbot Medical has reported findings from a single-centre, retrospective review of 20 consecutive outpatient procedures performed using the Liberty portable endovascular disposable robot assistant (PEDRA).

items.title: IHT Medical receives CE mark for Obtura liquid embolic system
items.summary: IHT Medical has announced that it has received a CE mark under the European Medical Device Regulation (MDR) for its Obtura liquid embolic system.

items.title: Obsidio conformable embolic achieves 100% technical and clinical success in real-world registry
items.summary: Obsidio (Boston Scientific) conformable embolic was safe and effective across a broad range of target vessels in the OCCLUDE registry, with 100% technical and clinical success and a low rate of major adverse events (MAEs), according to findings from a multicentre real-world study published in the Journal of Vascular…

items.title: CIRSE Emprint Microwave Ablation Registry places microwave ablation for CRLM benefit in ‘real world’
items.summary: This advertorial is sponsored by Medtronic. “The registry is a perfect package as it brings together two elements greatly needed: a prospective randomised controlled trial [RCT] and real-world data,” says Phillipe Pereria (SLK-Kliniken, Heilbronn, Germany), principal investigator for the prospective observational…

items.title: Cordica Medical launches PTFE-etched liner portfolio for interventional catheters
items.summary: Cordica Medical has launched a polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)-etched liner portfolio—lubricious ID, bond-ready etched outer diameter (OD) PTFE liners intended for interventional catheter designs.

items.title: Sirtex Medical acquires US FDA-approved Hourglass vascular plug
items.summary: Sirtex Medical has today announced it has acquired the Hourglass embolization plug—a US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k)-cleared vascular plug indicated to obstruct or reduce the rate of blood flow in the peripheral vasculature in vessels 6–8mm in diameter.

items.title: Medtronic to acquire Contego Medical
items.summary: Medtronic today announced its intent to acquire Contego Medical. A press release notes that the acquisition will build on Medtronic’s US distribution agreement with Contego, first announced in January 2025.

items.title: Siemens Healthineers changes name to Healthineers and rebrands in-vitro diagnostics business
items.summary: Siemens Healthineers has announced plans to change its name to Healthineers, with migration of this new brand set to begin with a three-year transition period in early 2027.

items.title: IR leaders say it’s time to move from position statements to practical action
items.summary: A panel at the British Society of Interventional Radiology (BSIR) meeting (4–6 November, Birmingham, UK) debated how the specialty can turn years of policy documents into real change.

items.title: Microbot Medical secures first OBL customer for Liberty endovascular robotic system
items.summary: Microbot Medical has announced that ELMNT IR, a multisite outpatient interventional radiology practice in California, has signed an order to purchase up to a 12-month supply of the company’s Liberty endovascular robotic system.

items.title: ACS and SIR release joint statement on rapid endovascular haemorrhage control in trauma care
items.summary: The American College of Surgeons (ACS) committee on trauma and the Society of Interventional Radiology (SIR) have issued a joint position statement positioning the role of interventional radiologists on multidisciplinary trauma teams and the importance of establishing reliable systems for rapid endovascular…

items.title: Merit Medical presents real-world data from AVF cohort of WRAP Global registry
items.summary: Merit Medical Systems has announced results from the arteriovenous fistula (AVF) cohort of the WRAP Global registry. Clinical data were presented at this year’s Controversies in Dialysis Access (CiDA) conference (29–31 October, Washington DC, USA).

items.title: Evident Vascular receives US FDA clearance for high-fidelity AI-powered IVUS imaging platform
items.summary: Evident Vascular has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of the Evident Vascular guidance system and Evident peripheral imaging catheters.

items.title: Prior embolization may reduce local tumour progression after microwave ablation for HCC, single-centre data suggest
items.summary: Microwave ablation demonstrated “excellent” technical and early oncologic outcomes, with low local tumour progression (LTP) and favourable disease-free and overall survival.

items.title: UK SIRT audit finds “significant” overall survival improvement in HCC
items.summary: A UK multicentre audit of selective internal radiation therapy (SIRT) practice in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients has demonstrated that treatment has “markedly” increased following the 2021 National Institutes of Health and Care Excellence (NICE) approval of the technique across the National Health Service…

items.title: Sex-specific analysis of SYMPHONY-PE finds comparable outcomes following aspiration thrombectomy
items.summary: Imperative Care has announced new findings from a pre-specified sex-specific analysis of the SYMPHONY-PE investigational device exemption (IDE) trial, which evaluated the Symphony thrombectomy system in patients with intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: BSIR 2026 live blog
Inquis Medical launches SENSE-PE all-comer postmarket registry of Aventus thrombectomy system
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the launch of SENSE-PE, an all-comer postmarket registry evaluating the safety and efficacy of the Aventus thrombectomy system in patients treated for acute pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Jupiter Endovascular reveals SPIRARE II post-hoc analysis for Vertex thrombectomy system
items.summary: Jupiter Endovascular has revealed findings from new analyses of its SPIRARE II pivotal trial showing that restoring normal pulmonary artery pressure with the Vertex thrombectomy system tracked with right heart recovery at 48 hours.

items.title: Real-world analysis fills gaps in PAE benefit across patient subpopulations
items.summary: Prostatic artery embolization (PAE) improved subjective/objective benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) parameters and sexual function at all timepoints, with “very few” exceptions, say investigators of a recent real-world analysis of patients undergoing the treatment.

items.title: Surmodics launches MetalPro direct-to-metal hydrophilic coatings for medical devices
items.summary: Surmodics has announced—at the opening of Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) 2026 (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA)—the launch of its MetalPro direct-to metal ultraviolet (UV) cure hydrophilic coatings engineered to bond directly to metal surfaces without primers or tie-layers.

items.title: Rampart extends total-body radiation protection to interventional imagers with Vanguard launch
items.summary: Rampart has announced the launch of Rampart Vanguard—a new radiation protection solution that has been purpose-built for interventional imagers working at the head of the table.

items.title: Instylla receives US FDA approval for Embrace hydrogel embolic system
items.summary: Instylla announced today that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved the expanded indication for the Embrace hydrogel embolic system (HES) to include embolization of peripheral arterial bleeds in vessels ≤6mm.

items.title: Radiation safety in endovascular procedures—what are we still overlooking?
items.summary: As the topic of radiation safety across various interventional specialties continues to garner increased interest, Melissa Kirkwood (Dallas, USA) homes in on the under-recognised issue of clinician hand exposure during these procedures. For neurointerventionists, fluoroscopy is essential to guiding complex procedures.

items.title: BD launches Liverty TIPS stent graft in the USA
items.summary: BD (Becton, Dickinson) has announced the US commercial launch of its BD Liverty transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) stent graft. According to the company, the next-generation TIPS system is designed to give physicians greater flexibility to tailor treatment for patients with portal hypertension.

items.title: UK government confirms indefinite recognition of CE-marked medical devices
items.summary: The UK government has confirmed that it will continue to accept CE-marked medical devices on a long-term basis, meaning devices and in vitro diagnostic devices (IVDs) already approved for the EU market will remain available to patients across the UK.

items.title: From fistula-first to fighting fibrin sheath—VASBI delegates discuss re-emergence of catheters in vascular access
items.summary: Delegates at this year’s Vascular Access Society of Britain and Ireland (VASBI) annual scientific meeting (24–25 September, Liverpool, UK) discussed and shared new data on one of the most contentious issues in dialysis access: the field’s increasing shift away from previous ‘fistula-first’ attitudes in favour of more…
